title: Shaheedo ki Safe Matam Bichaaaye
body:
Saheedo ki safe matam bichaye jiska g chahe
Janabe Fatema ko Ghar bulaye jiska g chahe
Dare zainul eba par khuld ki sogaat bat ti Hy
Muqqadar aake aapna azmaaye jiska g chahe
Na hogi salb hargiz maqsade sarwar ki azadi
Walao sajjad ko bedi pinhaye jiska g chahe
Sitamgar katle sheh ke baad ye apas me kehte the
Nabi ki aal ko ran me sataye jiska.....
Gaye Abbas maare abide bimaar gash me Hy
Muhafiz kaun Hy khaime jalaye jiska.....
Barae roshni marqad me apne sath sine par
Chirage daage matam leke Jaye jiska....
Bila tafreeqe mazhab ajr ka haqdar hota Hy
Ghame sajjad me aasu bahaye jiska g chahee
Batore khaas mulaiza farmaye
Ehad pehle Kare mazloomo bekas ki himayat ka
Phir uske baad parcham ko uthae jiska...
Pharaire ki Hawa aane nahi deti balao ko
Alam Abbas ka Ghar par lagaye jiska...
Dare shabbir par zeeshan taqdeere badalti Hy
Aqidat se yaha sar ko jhukaye jis..
Ye toh nahi kaha shahe mashrakain hu
Maula ne sar jhukanke kaha me hussain hu
